subject: Kary
text: Kary has 600 HP, yields 5000 Gold, and gives 4245 Exp.

subject: Kary
text: Kary has decent attack power, hits multiple times, uses Fir2, and can stun party members.

evidence.quote:
Kary has a decent attack power and the ability to throw multiple hits at her
targets.  That being said, her true power lies in her use of Fir2 and her
ability to stun your party members.

subject: Kary
text: Against Kary, have the Knight and Master attack, while the Red Wizard, Ninja, and Black Wizard cast Fast on proficient weapon users, and the White Wizard casts Inv2 and cures ailing allies.

evidence.quote:
This fight will require a few simple
steps to assure your victory, which are: Knight and Master attack, Red
Wizard, Ninja, and Black Wizard use Fast on the proficient weaponry users
(even themselves if necessary), and White Wizard will use Inv2 and then Cure
any ailing allies.

subject: Black Wizard
text: The Black Wizard can use attack spells against Kary, but they usually have minimal effect.

evidence.quote: Your Black Wizard can switch to attack spells if he so desires, but they have minimal effect most of the time.

subject: Fire Crystal
text: Touching the altar behind Kary causes the ORB to shine.

evidence.quote:
After defeating the fiend, step forward to touch the altar that he was
protecting, which will cause an ORB to shine!

subject: Gurgu Volcano
text: Continuing forward past the altar uses the warp to return to the outside world.

evidence.quote:
Now continue forward to use
the warp there to return to the outside world!

subject: Airship
text: To reach Onrac, fly west past the Dragon Islands and land the Airship on grass or plains to the southwest, then hike northeast across the river.

evidence.quote:
Find the Dragon Islands and fly west to pass near Onrac (if you see a
Waterfall in a river, head south to find Onrac).  Look for a landing spot
to the southwest for your Airship (grass and plains landings only!),

subject: Kope
text: In Onrac, Kope reports seeing a flying, shining object near the Waterfall to the north.

evidence.quote:
Now that is done with, wander through town to learn many interesting things,
including: a flying, shining object (sound familiar?) seen by Kope, Kope
himself saying it is near the Waterfall to the north, the caravan owner has
a mysterious object (mentioned in Gaia about the fairy being sold to a
caravan), the oasis is shop for the caravan (located to the west in the
desert), and that Dr. Unne (he is in Melmond) can speak Lefienish IF he ever
had the SLAB that sunk in the Sea Shrine.

subject: Waterfall
text: The Waterfall can be reached by paddling a canoe north along the river located west of Onrac.

evidence.quote:
Head west to find the river near
Onrac, start paddling north, and when you arrive at the Waterfall, set up a
Tent/Cabin/House to save your game if you like before entering the Waterfall
(I have NO IDEA how you can do so in a Canoe, yet here we are).

subject: Mud Gol
text: Mud Gols and Gas Dragons are dangerous and lethal encounters inside the Waterfall.

evidence.quote:
This place can be highly dangerous, with a few of the rough players in here
being Mud Gols and Gas Dragons (they are lethal).

subject: Waterfall
text: To navigate the Waterfall maze to the treasure room, go left and up at the first fork, left at the second, up-left at the third, down at the fourth, and left at the fifth until the path turns right into the room.

evidence.quote:
Start off by walking upwards to find a fork in the path, which is where you
will go left and then up.  After arriving at the next fork, head left to
find another fork, where your party will continue along the up-left path.
When the party finds a fork, head down to quickly find another fork that
should be followed to the left to where the path turns right to find a room.

subject: WzMummy
text: Entering the room triggers an attack by Mummy, WzMummy, Cocktrice, or Perilisk enemies, which can be defeated with Fir2, Fir3, Hrm2, Hrm3, Zeus Gauntlet, and physical attacks.

evidence.quote:
Upon entering, you will be attacked by a random setting of the following
monsters (Mummy, WzMummy, Cocktrice, Perilisk), so use Fir2/Fir3 or
Hrm2/Hrm3 (for the undead Mummies/WzMummies) along with hit all Weapon/Armor
(like the Zeus Gauntlet) and physical hits on the WzMummies to win.

subject: Robot
text: Talking to the robot in the Waterfall rewards the CUBE, which serves as a key to reach the FLOATING CASTLE.

evidence.quote:
Now you need to talk
to the robot (the shining object falling from the sky!) to receive the CUBE,
which is a key to reach the FLOATING CASTLE (mentioned numerous times by now
through townsfolk).

subject: Bottle
text: A Bottle is sold at the Caravan shop in the Oasis for 50000 Gold Pieces, which can be reached by landing the Airship on the patch of desert enclosed by grass.

evidence.quote:
Now, landing in the desert is not allowed as we know, BUT you can land your
Airship on the patch of desert in the middle of the grass outline which is
the Oasis!  Just land right on it, step off of the spot and then step back
to enter the Caravan to find that a Bottle is for sale at 50000 Gold Pieces
(totally worth the price of the Item I assure you).

subject: Gaia
text: Gaia can be reached by flying the Airship west to a lake surrounded by forest, then heading north.

evidence.quote:
Now that you have purchased it, it is time to
get back onto your Airship and take to the skies to fly west until you find
a lake surrounded by forest, which is where you will turn north to fly to
the enclosed town of Gaia.

subject: Bottle
text: Selecting the Bottle releases a Fairy that flies away.

evidence.quote:
Once you enter the town, select the Bottle and a Fairy will pop out and fly
away (you can do this before you arrive as well)!

subject: Fairy
text: At the fairy pond in Gaia, the appreciative Fairy draws OXYALE from the spring, allowing the party to use the submarine in Onrac to reach the Sea Shrine.

evidence.quote:
Now head up to the
previously empty Fairy pond to find out that she is so appreciative that she
will draw the OXYALE from the spring, which will allow your party to be able
to use the submarine to reach the submerged Sea Shrine!

subject: Submarine
text: Entering the Submarine in Onrac takes the party underwater to the Sea Shrine.

evidence.quote:
Head back to Onrac
(use your B Button + SELECT map if need be to find it), go into Onrac, buy
any supplies that you may need, and then go enter the Submarine to appear
underneath the waves.

subject: Blocked Off Room
text: To reach the blocked-off room on the mermaid floor, walk along the narrow path in the top left corner until the game wraps around.

evidence.quote:
Now you may have noticed one room
you can not reach conventionally, so you will need to bend the laws of
common sense and physics (I love video games that do that!) by heading for
the top left corner of the floor to take a narrow path to walk left for a
bit until the game wraps around and you arrive at the blocked off room!

subject: Treasure Chests
text: The three treasure chests in the wrapped-around blocked off room contain an Opal Helmet, Opal Gauntlet, and the SLAB.

evidence.quote:
Enter it to find three Treasure Chests containing: Opal Helmet, Opal

evidence.quote:

go up at the turn in the hallway to find a room with a Treasure Chest

subject: Sea Shrine
text: From the 9900 Gold chest room, head right, along the hallway right and up to the top left corner of the floor to descend via stairway.

evidence.quote:
containing 9900 Gold Pieces. ... Head right upon exiting the room, go along the
hallway to the right and then up, going to the top left corner of the floor
to descend to the next floor via the stairway.

subject: Sea Shrine
text: Head left and up, following the upward path at the next two forks past a room to find the descending stairs.

evidence.quote:
Head left and take the path leading upwards and continue following the
upward path at the next two forks to go straight up past a room to take the
stairs leading downwards.

subject: Sea Shrine Path
text: Valid step sequences through this section include: go right two, up two OR go up two, right two OR go up one, right one, up one, right one OR go up one, right two, up one OR go right one, up two, right one.

evidence.quote: This is a no brainer, but just in case you have troubles, here are the steps: go right two, up two OR go up two, right two OR go up one, right one, up one, right one OR go up one, right two, up one OR go right one, up two, right one. You will then arrive at the floor above in a different section than before.
